name: Bake 125 °C
notes: Drives absorbed moisture out of MSL 2a-5 parts before reflow. A part past its floor life -- MSL 3 is 168 hours at 30 C / 60% RH once the dry pack is open -- can flash that moisture to steam during reflow and crack internally. Four hours here; J-STD-033 gives the real figure per level and package thickness and it can run to days. Extend by running it more than once. The climb is deliberately unhurried, at 40% of what this oven can do: rapid heating of a part that is already wet is the failure this bake exists to prevent, and on a four-hour run the extra minute costs nothing. The last ten degrees are gentler still, at 0.15 C/s, which is what keeps the approach from carrying past the setpoint -- run 0009 peaked at 127.2 C against 125 and J-STD-033 allows only plus or minus five.
reference: J-STD-033 high-temperature bake for moisture-sensitive devices; curve generated from data/oven-characterisation.json
